mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id as planId, data_date as dataDate, status, begin_time as beginTime, end_time as endTime, msg, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM t_quartz_task_status WHERE status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_quartz_task_status(plan_id, data_date, status, begin_time, end_time, msg, update_time, create_time, create_date) VALUES (#{entity.planId}, #{entity.dataDate}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.beginTime}, #{entity.endTime}, #{entity.msg}, #{entity.updateTime}, #{entity.createTime}, DATE_FORMAT(#{entity.createTime}, '%Y%m%d'))
